exact_title: The Comparison of the Effectiveness of Dapagliflozin and Empagliflozin in the Prevention of Cardiovascular Outcomes in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes: A Network Meta-Analysis
source_type: systematic review and frequentist network meta-analysis including randomized and observational studies

figures.title: PRISMA flowchart of the study selection process
figures.key_content: 1,164 records identified; 178 duplicates removed; 986 screened; 955 excluded; 31 reports assessed; 19 excluded (5 irrelevant population, 3 reviews/editorials, 3 lacked required outcomes, 8 other); 12 studies included.

figures.title: Forest plot comparing MACE
figures.key_content: Reference dapagliflozin. Empagliflozin vs dapagliflozin RR 0.988 (95% CI 0.776-1.258); placebo vs dapagliflozin RR 1.147 (0.992-1.326).

figures.title: Forest plot comparing atrial fibrillation
figures.key_content: Reference dapagliflozin. Empagliflozin vs dapagliflozin RR 1.127 (95% CI 1.006-1.263); placebo vs dapagliflozin RR 1.241 (1.059-1.454).

figures.title: Forest plot comparing cardiovascular mortality
figures.key_content: Reference dapagliflozin. Empagliflozin vs dapagliflozin RR 1.07 (95% CI 0.75-1.53); placebo vs dapagliflozin RR 1.27 (0.92-1.75).

figures.title: Forest plot comparing myocardial infarction
figures.key_content: Reference dapagliflozin. Empagliflozin vs dapagliflozin RR 0.98 (95% CI 0.86-1.11); placebo vs dapagliflozin RR 1.12 (1.00-1.26).

figures.title: Forest plot comparing hospitalization for heart failure
figures.key_content: Reference dapagliflozin. Empagliflozin vs dapagliflozin RR 1.02 (95% CI 0.84-1.23); placebo vs dapagliflozin RR 1.43 (1.20-1.71). Results prose gives the empagliflozin-vs-dapagliflozin upper CI as 1.24.

tables.title: Included study characteristics
tables.key_content: 12 study entries. Table labels 6 RCTs and 6 observational studies; follow-up ranges from 4 to 50.4 months. Wiviott 2019 and Zelniker 2020 show identical dapagliflozin/placebo arm sizes and 50.4-month follow-up.

tables.title: Risk of bias assessment of included studies (RCTs)
tables.key_content: Six RCT entries. Most domains are low risk; Petrie 2020 has high risk for incomplete outcome data and unclear allocation concealment/other bias; Wiviott and Zinman contain several unclear judgments.

tables.title: Quality assessment of included studies (observational studies)
tables.key_content: Seven entries: Kim 2024 good, Lim 2023 fair, Lim 2024 good, Ozbek and Can 2023 good, Park 2022 good, Petrie 2020 good, Shao 2019 good. Petrie 2020 is also listed as an RCT in Tables 1 and 2.

tables.title: Risk of outcomes among different outcomes (pairwise comparison)
tables.key_content: NMA RR matrix for MACE, atrial fibrillation, cardiovascular mortality, myocardial infarction, and hospitalization for heart failure across dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, and placebo. Only dapagliflozin vs placebo for AF and both active drugs vs placebo for HHF have 95% CIs fully below 1; several other intervals cross or touch 1.

tables.title: GRADE NMA assessment
tables.key_content: Certainty labels range from low to high. Publication bias is marked unclear/unassessable. Several certainty labels are difficult to reconcile with the table's own inconsistency/imprecision judgments.

appendices_or_supplements.status: not present in selected source folder

coverage_decision: All six main-text figures and all six tables, including the appendix GRADE table, are represented as structured blocks in the SEA. Reference pages are extracted to a separate Markdown bibliography and not atomized as evidence.
omissions: Pure bibliography entries are excluded from ATOM extraction; they are preserved in the separate references Markdown file.
coverage_rationale: At 13 pages, the source can be fully mapped and reconciled in a single semantic pass without sacrificing visual/table coverage.
